about: A record with a 64-bit real field: built whole from its <sce:set>s, doubled and added to a running sum a field at a time, and replaced from a typed event payload without losing a bit of the real the payload carried. Whole-valued reals are written with a fraction (9.0) so that a reader which tells an integer from a real reads the expectation as the real it is. Expected values are derived from the document with an IEEE 754 reference (0.1 * 2 + 1.5 is 1.7, 9.0 + 1.7 is 10.7), not observed from a backend.

steps.note: the payload replaces the record field by field: 0.1 is held as the double 0.1 is
